title: B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering | KSET KPGU
content: Admission Inquiry Academics / KSET Computer Science & Engineering Krishna School of Emerging Technology & Applied Research at KPGU blends strong computing fundamentals with applied innovation, modern labs, and future-ready specialization pathways. 0 Established 0+ Faculty Members 0 Research Areas 0 Honors & Minors Tracks LEADERSHIP NOTE Message From the HOD KSET Dr. Rocky Upadhyay Head of Department, Computer Science & Engineering hod.cse.kset@kpgu.ac.in In today’s dynamic world, computer engineering stands at the forefront of transforming industries and driving technological advancements. Our department aims to prepare students not only to meet current demands but to innovate for the future. We strive to create a rigorous academic environment that encourages critical thinking, creativity, and practical problem-solving, while fostering learning, innovation, and collaboration. With rapid technological advancements shaping the world, our mission is to equip students with the skills, knowledge, and mindset needed to excel in an ever-evolving field. Our curriculum combines strong foundational courses with opportunities to explore cutting-edge areas such as Software Development, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Cybersecurity, IoT, Cloud Computing etc. Through practical labs, industry interactions, and real-world projects, we ensure that our students develop hands-on experience alongside theoretical knowledge. Our faculty are passionate educators and experienced professionals dedicated to student success. They bring a blend of academic and industry expertise, guide and mentor students, helping them build the competencies needed to thrive in competitive environments. We also encourage our students to engage in research, internships, and extracurricular activities to enhance their overall development and employability. We take pride in our graduates, who have gone on to make significant contributions in their fields, both in industry and academia. By joining the Department of Computer Engineering, you become part of a vibrant community focused on advancing knowledge and making a positive impact on society. As part of the global community of computer engineers, we are committed to nurturing talent that contributes meaningfully to society and technological progress. Let’s build a brighter, tech-enabled future together! “ With the idea that mentoring is a lifetime commitment, we motivate students to achieve academic excellence with valuable life lessons. ABOUT DEPARTMENT Building Future Technology Leaders 01 The Department of Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) at KSET-KPGU is a vibrant and forward-thinking academic community dedicated to preparing students for a future defined by innovation and technology. Our department, established in 2004, has been steadfastly committed to innovation and excellence, shaping a new path in education for future technology leaders. With the rapid growth of the digital landscape, our department is focused on cultivating skilled professionals and creative problem-solvers who are ready to tackle complex technological challenges. 02 Our curriculum is meticulously designed to blend foundational concepts with advanced technologies, providing students with a comprehensive education in areas such as algorithms, software development, artificial intelligence, machine learning, cybersecurity, IoT, data science. This blend ensures our students develop deep theoretical understanding and hands-on expertise, equipping them for successful careers in diverse industries. 03 Our faculty consists of experienced educators, researchers, and industry professionals who are committed to fostering a learning environment that emphasizes critical thinking, innovation, and collaboration. With access to state-of-the-art labs and resources, our students engage in practical, real-world projects that mirror the challenges faced in today’s tech industry. 04 In addition to academics, we emphasize research and development in cutting-edge areas such as cloud computing, IoT, robotics, and big data. Our students are encouraged to participate in faculty-led research, industry-sponsored projects, and national and international competitions, further strengthening their practical knowledge and professional network. We also offer Honors and Minors courses to keep our students up to date with the latest technologies and skills beyond the standard curriculum. 05 The CSE Department is equipped with high-end laboratories that include an Advanced Internet Lab, Research Lab, and Smart Classrooms, all designed for practical and hands-on learning. Each lab features the latest high-performance PCs, high-speed internet, and webcams to support immersive, real-time learning experiences. These resources ensure that our students have the tools they need for advanced research, collaboration, and skill development. 06 To prepare our students for the evolving demands of the industry, we offer numerous professional development opportunities through internships, partnerships with tech companies, and networking events. Our alumni are a testament to our success, excelling in careers at leading tech companies, innovative startups, and research institutions worldwide. 07 Our Computer Science and Engineering department isn’t just about academics, it’s about building a future where technology empowers and enriches lives. We invite you to join us and be part of a community that is shaping the next wave of technological advancements. VALUES & GOALS Vision & Mission Vision To evolve as a center of excellence in Computer Science & Engineering and to prepare value driven, globally competent Computer Engineers by imparting quality education through innovation, research, collaboration and contribute in the development of society at large. 01 To produce computer professionals and technocrats through proficient mentors and researchers to satisfy global needs. 02 To foster the state-of-art technologies and extend the platform to inculcate innovation and interdisciplinary research. 03 To imbibe moral and ethical values that creates responsible citizens with great human values and interpersonal skills. 04 To strengthen the partnership with industries, research organizations, and educational institutions that will enable the young graduate to emerge as a leader in academics or in entrepreneurship.
